{"reason":"Replace the medium/high supplier-switch action with alert-planner/immediate-expedite-review. V1’s 34 switches cost 34*45000=1.53M; each replacement costs 35000 and always arrives, saving at least 340000. The four stockouts, including medium inventory-days 2.8 and 5.3 failures, cannot increase, so the business gate holds.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
